Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds appearing in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Filter by document CHEMBL1123558. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
